name: Foldable Camera Drone
description: A small foldable quadcopter with a front camera, altitude hold and a phone app view. Comes with a remote, a modular battery, USB charger, 4 prop guards, 2 spare props, a screwdriver and a manual. Colours: black, and grey and white.

source.notes: Listing page needs login; no price, return rate or variant screenshot given. Supplier title claims 8K/4K/25 min/3 km: NOT repeated, unproven for E88-class drones. Contents from owner. Possible higher variant with carry case and 3 batteries (buyer photo). Contains lithium battery. HOLD: drones are restricted imports in Nigeria (ONSA end-user clearance, NCAA rules); owner to decide. Photos not yet made; e3c66270 is only 800px. Single-battery listing planned. Photos: cover from e3c66270 (800px, upscaled 1.5x, soft); black and grey from the 1688 hero shots padded with white, grid and text removed. 9ba83d31 and buyer photos dropped (text-heavy / casual / 3-battery variant).
